project.name: VocalLens (Flutter Text & Image to Voice)
project.description: Cross-platform Flutter AI application that extracts text from photos (OCR) or direct input, and synthesizes it with multiple distinct male and female voices in both English and Arabic, featuring speed control up to 5x, dynamic wave visualization, and full RTL layout.

architecturePattern: Layered Component Architecture (Services, Models, Widgets, Screens)

screens.role: Master studio controller hosting top bar, language toggle, dual TabBarView, and sticky voice player bar
Camera capture, gallery selection, desktop file picker, demo photo carousel, OCR text extraction card, and speed scroll
Rich text input editor, quick preset pills (English & Arabic), character/word counters, reading duration estimate, and speed scroll

widgets.role: Sticky bottom playback bar with sound wave visualizer, active voice badge, speed pill, tune drawer, and play/pause controls
Horizontal scrollable speed dial presets (0.25x to 5.0x) paired with a 95-step continuous slider wheel
Dynamic procedural voice wave visualizer responding in real-time to playback state
Interactive voice card with male/female badges, accent glow, and 1-tap sound preview
Horizontal image gallery with real-world English and Arabic photo cards for instant demonstration
Device voice explorer with search and tabs for All, Men, and Women voices
Fine-tuning controls for Voice Pitch (frequency), Speech Rate (up to 5x), and Volume
Archives recent speeches, timestamps, persona tags, word counts, and replaying triggers

features: Singleton pattern with ChangeNotifier for reactive UI updates
Asynchronous voice polling loop with retry to handle delayed browser/OS engine initialization
Heuristic voice classification into Male, Female, and Arabic categories based on name and locale tags
Dual-tier voice system: pre-tuned VoicePersonas + raw system voice fallback
Stop-before-speak cycle to clear previous utterance locks and guarantee audio parameter updates
Dynamic Arabic character detector (RegExp [\u0600-\u06FF]) to automatically route speech to Arabic synthesizers
Real-time word progress tracking via progress handlers
Conditional compilation: Native IO (dart:io) on Android/iOS/Desktop vs pure Web (dart:html/web)
Google ML Kit Text Recognition on Android and iOS devices
Free cloud OCR Space REST parser fallback for Web and Desktop environments
Universal byte and file path abstraction ensuring 0 compilation errors across all target platforms

models.description: Defines acoustic profiles (pitch, rate, preferred voice names) for 7 English personas and 5 Arabic personas across Men, Women, and AI
Comprehensive English and Arabic localization dictionary for all UI elements, buttons, and notifications
Sample cards containing real photo URLs and corresponding OCR texts in English and Arabic
Persistent record of previous conversions with source tags, timestamps, word counts, and persona tags

dataFlow.photoInputPipeline: Image (Camera/Gallery/File/Preset) -> Bytes/Path -> OcrService -> Extracted Text -> Text Controller -> Language Detection -> TtsService.speak() -> Speech Synthesis
dataFlow.textInputPipeline: User Typing/Preset Selection -> Text Controller -> Language Detection -> TtsService.speak() -> Speech Synthesis
